title: Adaptive-memory audit: R and Julia reproducibility materials
description: Public R and Julia reproducibility materials for the article "Auditing psychological inferences about memory from adaptive learning logs: Cognitive-model recovery, policy logging, and randomized validation". Includes analysis source code, one minimized de-identified empirical transition table, formal simulation and empirical outputs, generated figures and tables, and validation records. Software under MIT; de-identified data and generated research products under CC BY 4.0.
